comment: The LT output carries the tooltip EQ, the same as the output beside it, because Osc22.cpp:107 passes the wrong name. The EQ output is a sample and hold: it takes the value of the first wave whenever the two waves come within the Win setting of each other, Osc22.cpp:208-209, and the window is divided by sixteen while Oversample is on, Osc22.cpp:168. The Mix jack multiplies the Mix knob rather than adding to it, Osc22.cpp:187. The channel count of every output comes from the V/Oct A jack.
